title: Engenheiro de API Gateway Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga

Estamos colaborando com uma empresa portuguesa de referência no setor do varejo , presente em Portugal e Espanha. Neste contexto, procuramos alguém com energia, responsabilidade e motivação para assumir a função de ENGENHEIRO DE API GATEWAY , numa das iniciativas que estamos a conduzir com este cliente.

Neste projeto, a pessoa que se juntar ao time irá trabalhar remotamente com colegas da FCamara e do Cliente baseados em Portugal.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Esta pessoa terá como responsabilidade assegurar que as plataformas de API Gateway do Cliente estão disponíveis e configuradas adequadamente para que os serviços de integração funcionem com alta disponibilidade, performance e segurança.


Requisitos e qualificações

Para esta posição, procuramos alguém com experiência em funções semelhantes.

Você é a pessoa certa se atender estes requisitos obrigatórios :

  • Conhecimento no setup e utilização de soluções de API/Event Gateway + API/Event Management (Apigee, Kong, Gravitee, etc.);
  • Experiência com Git e pipelines CI/CD (Argo CD, Github Actions, etc.);
  • Experiência na utilização de plataformas de observabilidade;


e iremos olhar com muito bons olhos se também atender estes requisitos valorizados

  • Experiência em ambientes com elevado volume de transações e integrações

Para além do conhecimento técnico, também esperamos que tenhas um perfil de colaboração e trabalho em equipe :

  • Capacidade para compreender os requisitos e as soluções técnicas
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação
  • Espírito crítico e foco na melhoria contínua
  • Forte orientação para a entrega e cumprimento de prazos e objetivos

Informações adicionais

Esta é uma posição Full Remote , atuando com equipes do Cliente baseados em Portugal e é específica para quem reside no Brasil (em qualquer cidade ou estado).

Esta posição está inserida num projeto de longa duração .

Idiomas: Nesta posição, o trabalho decorre em língua portuguesa . Inglês será valorizado, especialmente para interações em contexto internacional.

Modelo de Contratação: Temos flexibilidade no modelo de contratação. A nossa equipe de recrutamento fornecerá todos os detalhes e informações sobre o tipo de contrato, remuneração e benefícios, ajustados à tua localização e situação profissional.

Nacionalidade, Residência e Visto: Esta posição não contempla apoio, por parte da FCamara, na obtenção de visto ou autorização de residência para Portugal ou qualquer outro país.

title: Scrum Master Sr
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem uma oportunidade imediata para Scrum Masters experientes e com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e transformação de negócios através do lean-agile. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades. Junte-se ao nosso time e seja um agente facilitador de resultados de negócios através dos conceitos de Business Agility, Lean, Agile, Kanban e SAFe.


O Scrum Master trabalhará com equipes de entrega ágil para aprimorar e habilitar o desempenho de nível de equipe e entrega de valor usando o Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).


Duties and Responsibilities:

· Coach de equipes referentes aos valores e princípios lean-agile;

· Facilitar cerimônias ágeis no nível de time (Retrospectiva, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review, Sprint Planning, Refining), garantindo o entendimento e engajamento total da equipe em tais;

· Promover o mindset e práticas de melhoria contínua para as equipes ágeis;

· Integração das melhores práticas e padrões de agilidade em um contexto altamente regulado;

· Fomentar o senso de responsabilidade compartilhada nas equipes e stakeholders;

· Facilitar a resolução de ou impedimentos existentes para os times;

· Gerenciar interdependências entre equipes ágeis;

· Trabalhar com Product Owners para apoiar o planejamento de Curto Prazo e evolução da definição/priorização do Backlog de produto do time;

· Proteger as equipes de interferências externas que possam impactar princípios de agilidade, produtividade da equipe e/ou estágio de formação da equipe;

· Participar e auxiliar na facilitação de todas as cerimônias em um ambiente ágil escalado (SAFe Essential);


Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

· Experiência comprovada como Scrum Master/Agile Master (conhecimento será testado);

· Experiência em ambiente regido pelas cerimônias do SAFe

· Vivência de TI em projetos de desenvolvimento de soluções complexas e de alta disponibilidade

· Experiência com diferentes modelos, métricas e cerimônias no nível de equipe ágil

· Experiência com ferramentas de gerenciamento de trabalho ágil (Jira), incluindo configuração, planejamento e relatórios

· Capacidade promover agilidade em diferentes cenários sendo responsável por garantir que as equipes entendam e operem de acordo com os valores e princípios de agilidade

· Conhecimento em outros métodos e práticas ágeis além do Scrum

Minimum Education:

· Bachelor’s Degree

Required Certifications:

· Possuir certificação KMP, PSPM e MGT 3.0

· Possuir certificação SAFe (plus)


Other:

· English (plus)

Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades. Junte-se ao nosso time e seja um agente facilitador de resultados de negócios através dos conceitos de Business Agility, Lean, Agile, Kanban e SAFe.


O Scrum Master trabalhará com equipes de entrega ágil para aprimorar e habilitar o desempenho de nível de equipe e entrega de valor usando o Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).


Duties and Responsibilities:

· Coach de equipes referentes aos valores e princípios lean-agile;

· Facilitar cerimônias ágeis no nível de time (Retrospectiva, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review, Sprint Planning, Refining), garantindo o entendimento e engajamento total da equipe em tais;

· Promover o mindset e práticas de melhoria contínua para as equipes ágeis;

· Integração das melhores práticas e padrões de agilidade em um contexto altamente regulado;

· Fomentar o senso de responsabilidade compartilhada nas equipes e stakeholders;

· Facilitar a resolução de ou impedimentos existentes para os times;

· Gerenciar interdependências entre equipes ágeis;

· Trabalhar com Product Owners para apoiar o planejamento de Curto Prazo e evolução da definição/priorização do Backlog de produto do time;

· Proteger as equipes de interferências externas que possam impactar princípios de agilidade, produtividade da equipe e/ou estágio de formação da equipe;

· Participar e auxiliar na facilitação de todas as cerimônias em um ambiente ágil escalado (SAFe Essential);


Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

· Experiência comprovada como Scrum Master/Agile Master (conhecimento será testado);

· Experiência em ambiente regido pelas cerimônias do SAFe

· Vivência de TI em projetos de desenvolvimento de soluções complexas e de alta disponibilidade

· Experiência com diferentes modelos, métricas e cerimônias no nível de equipe ágil

· Experiência com ferramentas de gerenciamento de trabalho ágil (Jira), incluindo configuração, planejamento e relatórios

· Capacidade promover agilidade em diferentes cenários sendo responsável por garantir que as equipes entendam e operem de acordo com os valores e princípios de agilidade

· Conhecimento em outros métodos e práticas ágeis além do Scrum

Minimum Education:

· Bachelor’s Degree

Required Certifications:

· Possuir certificação KMP, PSPM e MGT 3.0

· Possuir certificação SAFe (plus)


Other:

· English (plus)

title: Product Designer
description:
For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Product Designer to own the end-to-end user experience for our Carnegie Audiences suite of products (careerexplorer.com and supplemental products), including the integration and design of new Agentic AI interactions. You will be responsible for translating complex user needs and business goals into intuitive, elegant, and effective design solutions. This role requires a strong focus on core user experience, user flows, and wireframing, in addition to high-quality visual user interface (UI) execution.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • User Experience (UX) Strategy and Design
  • Lead the design process from initial concept and user research through to final implementation and iteration, focusing on complex user flows, information architecture, and system design.
  • Develop and refine wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups to communicate design intent and test hypotheses with users and stakeholders.
  • Conduct usability testing, analyze user data, and gather feedback to drive continuous improvement of the product experience.
  • Design and integrate Agentic AI experiences into product flows, ensuring a seamless, trustworthy, and effective interaction between the user and the AI system.
  • User Interface (UI) Design and Visual Execution
  • Create polished, high-fidelity visual designs and detailed design specifications that adhere to brand guidelines and accessibility standards.
  • Maintain and contribute to our existing Design System, ensuring consistency, scalability, and efficiency across all product touchpoints.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all product outputs, focusing on design principles that enhance clarity and drive user adoption.
  • Data Product Development
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into data product features.
  • Direct the building and maintenance of data-centric applications and tools that leverage machine learning insights.
  • Implement and manage MLOps and CI/CD workflows for efficient model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure data governance, quality, and integrity across all analytical solutions.
  • Collaboration and Implementation
  • Partner closely with Product Managers to define product strategy and requirements, ensuring design solutions align with business objectives and technical constraints.
  • Collaborate with front-end engineers to ensure accurate design implementation and a seamless, high-quality user experience post-launch.
  • Participate in agile development processes, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and design critiques.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • UX/UI Acumen: Exceptional ability to translate strategic product goals into logical user flows and visually compelling, intuitive user interfaces, evidenced by a strong public portfolio of work on consumer-facing web products.
  • Technical Design Proficiency: Expertise in current design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD) for creating high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, and specifications.
  • Design Ownership and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a design portfolio autonomously, proactively identify design opportunities, and take ownership of the product’s end-to-end user experience.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively navigate complex design challenges and continuously seek elegant solutions that balance user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively present design rationale to non-technical stakeholders and facilitate productive design critiques.


Requirements:

  • Advanced Proficiency in UX Design: Deep expertise in the full lifecycle of UX design, including user research, wireframing, journey mapping, and developing interactive prototypes that demonstrate complex user flows.
  • Expert UI/Visual Design Experience: Strong, hands-on experience in high-fidelity visual design, typography, color theory, and creating/maintaining design systems for web products.
  • Consumer Web Focus: Demonstrated ability to design and launch successful consumer-facing products on the web.
  • Portfolio: Mandatory submission of a portfolio (e.g., personal website, Dribbble, GitHub) that clearly demonstrates a focus on design thinking, user flows, and high-end aesthetic execution for consumer web applications.


Nice-to-haves:

  • AI/ML Design: Experience designing user experiences for AI/ML-powered features or familiarity with the principles of Agentic AI.
  • Familiarity with motion design and animation principles to enhance user interactions.
  • Proficiency with front-end code (HTML, CSS, JavaScript frameworks) to facilitate better collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in Design, HCI, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on Product Design (UX/UI) for consumer-facing web applications, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Low-Code (Especialista em Automação e n8n)
description:
A Practia está presente em 7 países liderando projetos de automação e transformação digital em grandes clientes. Somos uma das empresas de negócios e tecnologia mais prestigiadas da América Latina com metodologia e equipe técnica especializadas em automação e Hyperautomation.

Possuímos parceria e certificação com as principais plataformas de mercado, atuando como Diamond Partner da UiPath, Platinum Partner da Automation Anywhere, Gold Partner da Microsoft e Silver Partner da IBM. Nossa experiência e vivência em serviços de automação nos garantir, entre diversas premiações, o selo de USN (UiPath Service Network) e LATAM Partner of the Year da UiPath.

Estamos buscando um(a) Desenvolvedor (a) Low-Code (Especialista em Automação e n8n). O profissional será responsável por desenhar, desenvolver e manter fluxos de automação complexos, conectando diferentes plataformas via API para otimizar processos operacionais e de negócio. O foco principal será a construção de ecossistemas integrados e escaláveis utilizando o n8n como orquestrador principal.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições


  • Planejamento de Workflows: Desenhar a arquitetura lógica de automações antes da implementação, garantindo eficiência e tratamento de erros.
  • Desenvolvimento no n8n: Criar, testar e publicar fluxos de automação utilizando nós nativos e personalizados.
  • Integração de Sistemas: Consumir e expor APIs (REST/JSON) para garantir o fluxo de dados entre ferramentas (CRMs, ERPs, Bancos de Dados, IA, etc).
  • Manipulação de Webhooks: Configurar e gerenciar gatilhos em tempo real para disparar ações baseadas em eventos externos.

title: Analista de Portfólio de Projetos - Sênior
description:
Com mais de 40 anos de história, somos pioneiros e especialistas no segmento de empréstimos consignados. E também, em investimentos de renda fixa e variável com o Paraná Banco Investimentos.

Oferecemos empréstimos com segurança e transparência para quem deseja quitar dívidas maiores, investir em algo ou realizar um sonho. Com o propósito transformar soluções financeiras em sorrisos!


E o que nos torna especiais?

  • Somos apaixonados pelo sorriso: Buscamos as melhores experiências para os nossos clientes, valorizamos as pessoas e somos apaixonados pela empresa.
  • Somos inovadores e buscamos simplicidade: Testamos, aprendemos e pensamos sempre em melhorias contínuas.
  • Somos flexíveis e promovemos mudanças: Cultivamos a adaptabilidade como virtude, incentivando e promovendo constantes transformações para alcançar o melhor de cada jornada.
  • Somos guiados por dados: Os nossos objetivos são claros, se não podemos medir, não podemos fazer. Somos direcionados pela eficiência e aproveitamos ao máximo os recursos disponíveis.


Nossas vagas são destinadas à todas as pessoas! Sem distinção de gênero, raça, cor, idade, orientação sexual ou etnia.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Acompanhar o andamento das ações do portfólio afim de ter as informações mais corretas e assertivas de cada iniciativa cadastrada;
  • Avaliar riscos de execução e negócio dos projetos;
  • Construir apresentações executivas e estratégicas que demonstrem o status do portfólio;
  • Analise critica de relatórios e implementação de melhoria continua no acompanhamento de projetos;
  • Desenvolver e implementar frameworks de governança para monitorar o progresso das iniciativas;
  • Garantir a conformidade com a governança e processos internos;
  • Realizar análises de viabilidade e impacto financeiro das iniciativas;
  • Facilitar workshops e reuniões para promover o entendimento e a colaboração entre as partes interessadas;
  • Promover a capacitação das equipes em metodologias de gestão de valor e praticar as ações e etapas padrões da governança.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência sólida em gestão de projetos e programas, preferencialmente em ambientes corporativos bancários ou afins;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis e experiência em gestão de portfólio ao menos 2 anos;
  • Habilidades analíticas e de resolução de problemas;
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade para trabalhar em equipe;
  • Conhecimento e destreza no Calculo de WSJF.


Modelo de trabalho:

Presencial: Para equipes de Call Center, com jornada integral no escritório.

Híbrido : Trabalho remoto combinado com presença obrigatória no escritório às terças, quartas e quintas-feiras.

Remoto: Trabalho integralmente remoto, podendo haver viagens ocasionais para a sede em Curitiba/PR.


O que temos para você:

Vale Alimentação e Vale Refeição (Sem descontos!)

title: Windows Architect / Azure Infrastructure Architect
description:
Windows Architect / Azure Infrastructure Architect

Competency Level: C5 / C6

Role Type: CLT Full Time

Work Model: 100% Remote in Brazil


About the Role


We are seeking an experienced Windows Architect / Azure Infrastructure Architect with deep expertise in Azure IaaS/PaaS, Windows infrastructure, and large-scale cloud migrations . This role is responsible for leading complex Azure solutioning initiatives, designing target architectures, and guiding infrastructure teams through on-premises to Azure transformations.

The ideal candidate will bring strong technical leadership , hands-on architecture experience, and the ability to engage with stakeholders across business and IT functions.

Key Responsibilities

Azure & Cloud Architecture

  • Lead Azure infrastructure assessments and migrations using Azure Migrate .
  • Drive end-to-end Azure solutioning for large and complex migration programs.
  • Design and implement Azure Landing Zones , ensuring alignment with security, networking, and governance standards.
  • Define Azure target-state architectures , including HLDs, LLDs, BoM, licensing, and pricing details .
  • Provide architecture covering business, application, infrastructure, security, and cost optimization aspects.
  • Ensure solutions meet TCO and ROI objectives .

Windows & Infrastructure Expertise

  • Architect, manage, and troubleshoot Windows Server environments (compute, memory, I/O, networking, clusters).
  • Lead server consolidation initiatives, including Windows clustering .
  • Strong hands-on experience with:
  • Windows File & Print Services
  • DNS, DHCP, WINS administration
  • DFS configuration and management
  • Windows Server upgrades and migrations
  • Backup and restoration (OS and data)
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues in Azure and on-prem Windows environments .

Leadership & Governance

  • Lead and technically govern infrastructure teams of 5+ members .
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders, customers, and project managers to understand requirements and deliver solutions.
  • Identify risks and implement robust risk mitigation strategies .
  • Participate in post-project reviews , capturing lessons learned and driving continuous improvement.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 13+ years of overall IT experience.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in Azure Infrastructure (IaaS/PaaS).
  • Strong experience across Azure Networking, Azure IAM, Azure Key Vault, Storage, Security, SIAM, and DC environments .
  • Proven experience migrating on-prem workloads to Azure .
  • Experience working in regulated industries such as Banking, Healthcare, or Insurance .
  • Ability to work in 24×7 support environments and flexible shifts.

Secondary / Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Design of Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery (BC/DR) solutions.
  • Exposure to identity, governance, and monitoring solutions in Azure.
  • Experience in multi-domain enterprise environments .

Certifications (Preferred)

  • AZ-305 – Designing Microsoft Azure Infrastructure Solutions
  • AZ-104 – Microsoft Azure Administrator

Soft Skills

  • Strong customer-facing skills and ability to present solution designs.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Positive attitude and strong team collaboration.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

title: Senior Front-End Software Engineer (React.js / React Native / TypeScript)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Front-End Software Engineer with 5+ years of professional front-end development experience using React.js, React Native, and TypeScript for our U.K. / U.S. client. You will design, build, and maintain high‑impact user interfaces — from customer dashboards and data visualizations to our React Native mobile app.

Our client is a nature data and intelligence company on a mission to drive large-scale nature recovery. They combine data, science, and technology to help enterprises value and restore nature, creating measurable environmental and economic impact.


Responsibilities

  • Own front-end delivery for key product surfaces across web and mobile taking features from technical feasibility through technical design, implementation, release, and iteration
  • Build and evolve UI foundations including component patterns, design-system primitives, reusable layouts, and interaction standards that keep UX consistent as the product scales
  • Translate product and design intent into clear, intuitive user flows sweating the details on information hierarchy, micro-interactions, accessibility, and polish
  • Ship performant, data-heavy interfaces in Next.js / React.js, with strong attention to perceived performance (e.g., loading states, empty states, progressive disclosure, and responsiveness)
  • Contribute meaningfully to the React Native app, delivering cross-platform UI and shared patterns where it makes sense, while handling platform-specific edge cases when needed
  • Use automated testing to ensure the UI quality, stability, and performance
  • Partner tightly with Product, Design, and Tech Lead to scope work into thin, shippable increments, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and keep delivery moving without sacrificing quality


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of professional experience building production, front-end applications with React.js and TypeScript
  • Experience building and supporting cross-platform, React Native features in a production application
  • Strong eye for UI and UX quality, paying close attention to interaction behavior, information hierarchy, accessibility, and polish
  • Proven experience implementing and operating within a component library / design system (e.g., tokens, reusable components, consistency, and documentation) in close collaboration with Design
  • Strong fundamentals in state management, responsive design, and performance optimization including perceived performance (e.g., loading states, skeletons, optimistic UI, and smooth interactions)
  • Comfortable taking ambiguous product requirements and turning them into clear UI flows, iterating quickly with stakeholders, and owning outcomes
  • Shareable portfolio or examples of UI work (e.g. links, screenshots) as well as the ability to explain what you personally owned and enhanced
  • Proactive mindset and the ability to self-manage in a distributed environment
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment


Desired Experience

  • Experience with mobile release workflows (App Store / Play Store), build tooling, and troubleshooting React Native native-module / platform-specific issues
  • Experience with data visualization libraries (e.g., D3.js, Recharts) and/or map-based UI (e.g., Mapbox)


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior Front-End Software Engineer (React.js / React Native / TypeScript)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Front-End Software Engineer with 5+ years of professional front-end development experience using React.js, React Native, and TypeScript for our U.K. / U.S. client. You will design, build, and maintain high‑impact user interfaces — from customer dashboards and data visualizations to our React Native mobile app.

Our client is a nature data and intelligence company on a mission to drive large-scale nature recovery. They combine data, science, and technology to help enterprises value and restore nature, creating measurable environmental and economic impact.


Responsibilities

  • Own front-end delivery for key product surfaces across web and mobile taking features from technical feasibility through technical design, implementation, release, and iteration
  • Build and evolve UI foundations including component patterns, design-system primitives, reusable layouts, and interaction standards that keep UX consistent as the product scales
  • Translate product and design intent into clear, intuitive user flows sweating the details on information hierarchy, micro-interactions, accessibility, and polish
  • Ship performant, data-heavy interfaces in Next.js / React.js, with strong attention to perceived performance (e.g., loading states, empty states, progressive disclosure, and responsiveness)
  • Contribute meaningfully to the React Native app, delivering cross-platform UI and shared patterns where it makes sense, while handling platform-specific edge cases when needed
  • Use automated testing to ensure the UI quality, stability, and performance
  • Partner tightly with Product, Design, and Tech Lead to scope work into thin, shippable increments, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and keep delivery moving without sacrificing quality


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of professional experience building production, front-end applications with React.js and TypeScript
  • Experience building and supporting cross-platform, React Native features in a production application
  • Strong eye for UI and UX quality, paying close attention to interaction behavior, information hierarchy, accessibility, and polish
  • Proven experience implementing and operating within a component library / design system (e.g., tokens, reusable components, consistency, and documentation) in close collaboration with Design
  • Strong fundamentals in state management, responsive design, and performance optimization including perceived performance (e.g., loading states, skeletons, optimistic UI, and smooth interactions)
  • Comfortable taking ambiguous product requirements and turning them into clear UI flows, iterating quickly with stakeholders, and owning outcomes
  • Shareable portfolio or examples of UI work (e.g. links, screenshots) as well as the ability to explain what you personally owned and enhanced
  • Proactive mindset and the ability to self-manage in a distributed environment
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment


Desired Experience

  • Experience with mobile release workflows (App Store / Play Store), build tooling, and troubleshooting React Native native-module / platform-specific issues
  • Experience with data visualization libraries (e.g., D3.js, Recharts) and/or map-based UI (e.g., Mapbox)


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Sr. Product Analyst
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our flag ship product is a Chromium browser, that provides a powerful and secure way to search the web; and our growing ecosystem includes a portfolio of innovative mobile products. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Product Analyst to join our team and help drive data-informed decisions to help grow and optimize our browser products. This individual will play a critical role in analyzing user behavior, evaluating feature performance, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high quality data insights. This role is best suited for a confident self-starter and requires a blend of creative vision, technical know-how, strong communication / presentation skills, and exceptional organizational skills.


Key Responsibilities


Data Analysis, Insights, & Skills

  • Extract, clean, and analyze data using SQL to understand product performance, user behavior, and business trends
  • Proficient at using / analyzing excel, dashboards, reports, and KPIs to monitor product health/performance
  • Understands what constitutes “accuracy” for various data sets and can run checks to verify the accuracy of a data set
  • Automatically goes the “extra step” on assigned tasks.
  • Able to provide actionable recommendations to product managers and leadership teams
  • Capable of providing clear and concise write-ups for complex analysis
  • Capable of performing tasks with speed and efficiency


Personality Traits

  • People excel in this position that are self – starters, confident, and competitive
  • They are capable of self-management and independent decision making
  • They have strong time/priority management skills
  • They are team players and can see problems from multiple points of view.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication

  • Work closely with Product Managers, Engineering, QA’s, User Acquisition, and Design teams to translate business requirements into analytical solutions
  • Partner with stakeholders to identify key metrics and measure the success of product initiatives
  • Understands the differences between team level updates and executive level updates


Experimentation & Optimization

  • Support A/B testing and experimentation frameworks to validate hypotheses and inform product decisions
  • Analyze experiment results and recommend next steps for product improvements


Agile/Scrum Processes

  • Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and daily stand-ups to align analytics work with product development priorities
  • Deliver insights in iterative cycles that align with Agile methodologies


Who You Are


  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or similar)
  • 5+ years of firsthand experience in management/analysis of data within a Structured Query Language (SQL) database (Preferred: Microsoft SQL Server, Amazon Redshift) with proven SQL and query writing skills
  • Experience collecting and analyzing data and reporting on the results using Excel or a statistical software package
  • Demonstrated ability to extract and assimilate data from multiple sources and communicate analysis in a concise, easy-to-understand, and actionable format
  • Strong proficiency in SQL for data manipulation and analysis
  • Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum frameworks and working in iterative development cycles
  • Ability to communicate complex findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Product Analyst to join our team and help drive data-informed decisions to help grow and optimize our browser products. This individual will play a critical role in analyzing user behavior, evaluating feature performance, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high quality data insights. This role is best suited for a confident self-starter and requires a blend of creative vision, technical know-how, strong communication / presentation skills, and exceptional organizational skills.


Key Responsibilities


Data Analysis, Insights, & Skills

  • Extract, clean, and analyze data using SQL to understand product performance, user behavior, and business trends
  • Proficient at using / analyzing excel, dashboards, reports, and KPIs to monitor product health/performance
  • Understands what constitutes “accuracy” for various data sets and can run checks to verify the accuracy of a data set
  • Automatically goes the “extra step” on assigned tasks.
  • Able to provide actionable recommendations to product managers and leadership teams
  • Capable of providing clear and concise write-ups for complex analysis
  • Capable of performing tasks with speed and efficiency


Personality Traits

  • People excel in this position that are self – starters, confident, and competitive
  • They are capable of self-management and independent decision making
  • They have strong time/priority management skills

  • Support A/B testing and experimentation frameworks to validate hypotheses and inform product decisions

  • Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and daily stand-ups to align analytics work with product development priorities
  • Deliver insights in iterative cycles that align with Agile methodologies


Who You Are


  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or similar)
  • 5+ years of firsthand experience in management/analysis of data within a Structured Query Language (SQL) database (Preferred: Microsoft SQL Server, Amazon Redshift) with proven SQL and query writing skills
  • Experience collecting and analyzing data and reporting on the results using Excel or a statistical software package
  • Demonstrated ability to extract and assimilate data from multiple sources and communicate analysis in a concise, easy-to-understand, and actionable format
  • Strong proficiency in SQL for data manipulation and analysis
  • Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum frameworks and working in iterative development cycles
  • Ability to communicate complex findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences

description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. We are looking for Oracle Fusion who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

We are seeking an Oracle Business Systems Analyst (BSA), with functional experience with Oracle ERP Cloud, Supply Chain processes and Oracle GTM (Global Trade Management) module. Optionally, also have experience with both of the Order to Cash and Procure to Pay business processes and modules including (but not limited to): AP, AR, G/L, Cash Management, Order Management, and Inventory. This BSA will help define the integration of our GTM Application with Oracle products. Our ONESOURCE Integrations for Oracle is a key component of our product suite. As an Oracle BSA, he will be responsible for developing functional requirement, API mapping specs, test cases plans, validating acceptance criteria and documentation, as related to the integration processes between Oracle and ONESOURCE Global Trade.



Tasks Performed :


• Work closely with customers, prospects and Product Management in setting the direction of current and future the ONESOURCE Global Trade Integration for Oracle as well as helping to continue to maintain ONESOURCE Global Trade integration for Oracle competitive differentiation.


• Perform detailed analysis of ONSOURCE business integration with Oracle modules, primarily GTM to determine opportunities to strengthen and expand integration design.


• Prepare detailed Oracle Integration Requirement Specs & Functional Documentation with associated use cases, Define interface mapping rules, PowerPoint presentations, and other documents to explain requirements to Development, support teams, partners and customers.


• Demonstrate the ability to research and understand Oracle Fusion APIs.


• Perform feature validation of functionality, QA in test script creation and automation, and assist with end-user documentation


• Perform Oracle application configuration settings and options for relevant modules


• Assist in providing 2nd level support and training to Support and Professional Services staff



Essential Functions:


• Maintain a working relationship with internal customers including Product Development, Professional Services, Customer Advocacy, as well as Oracle via the Oracle Partner Program


• Gather, define and document Oracle business requirements


• Work closely with application developers, other BSA’s and QA testers throughout the entire product life cycle


• Participate in customer calls, visits and meetings to gather requirements and resolve issues


• Support product rollouts and implementations as domain expert and/or primary business interface to partner domain experts. Follow product into the field to ensure customer success.


• Support current products, including 2nd level support analysis, patch assessment, and work-around investigation


• Provide business and data integration expertise to customers, partners and internal professional services personnel as needed.



Desired Job Experience:


• Requires a minimum of 1-3 years functional experience in key Oracle modules (Supply Chain Management and GTM), including requirements gathering, design, configuration, unit testing and integration testing.


• Experience with a full life cycle Oracle implementations


• Experience with Oracle ERP Cloud (Fusion) required


• Strong analytical, design and documentation skills


• Oracle design, configuration and hands on experience


• Exposure to broad financial processes and systems experience across quote-to-cash and procure-to-pay business functions (billing, order management, accounts receivable, purchasing, accounts payable, general ledger.)


• Experience with standard financial processes and ability to overlay the process understanding onto multiple financial business systems packages.


• Previous experience working in a software company strongly desired.


• Desirable experience in Oracle modules AP, AR, G/L, Order Management and Purchasing .


• Previous work with Oracle R12 EBS is a plus


• Experience with ONESOURCE Global Trade will be a plus



Other Qualifications:


• Excellent communication and presentation skills in interacting with management and communicating functional vision to both internal and external constituencies


• Strong customer-facing experience and skills.


• Experience with Agile Product Delivery Process , specifically Scrum is a plus


• Strong communication and presentation skills


• Technical/ Oracle development experience (Foundation, SQL*Plus, System Administration) is a plus


• Technical experience working with APIs (SOAP and REST) and API tools, such as SoapUi and Postman is a plus


• Ability to multi-task and work under tight deadlines in a fast paced environment

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

We are looking for Oracle Fusion who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

We are seeking an Oracle Business Systems Analyst (BSA), with functional experience with Oracle ERP Cloud, Supply Chain processes and Oracle GTM (Global Trade Management) module. Optionally, also have experience with both of the Order to Cash and Procure to Pay business processes and modules including (but not limited to): AP, AR, G/L, Cash Management, Order Management, and Inventory. This BSA will help define the integration of our GTM Application with Oracle products. Our ONESOURCE Integrations for Oracle is a key component of our product suite. As an Oracle BSA, he will be responsible for developing functional requirement, API mapping specs, test cases plans, validating acceptance criteria and documentation, as related to the integration processes between Oracle and ONESOURCE Global Trade.



Tasks Performed :


• Work closely with customers, prospects and Product Management in setting the direction of current and future the ONESOURCE Global Trade Integration for Oracle as well as helping to continue to maintain ONESOURCE Global Trade integration for Oracle competitive differentiation.


• Perform detailed analysis of ONSOURCE business integration with Oracle modules, primarily GTM to determine opportunities to strengthen and expand integration design.


• Prepare detailed Oracle Integration Requirement Specs & Functional Documentation with associated use cases, Define interface mapping rules, PowerPoint presentations, and other documents to explain requirements to Development, support teams, partners and customers.


• Demonstrate the ability to research and understand Oracle Fusion APIs.


• Perform feature validation of functionality, QA in test script creation and automation, and assist with end-user documentation


• Perform Oracle application configuration settings and options for relevant modules


• Assist in providing 2nd level support and training to Support and Professional Services staff



Essential Functions:


• Maintain a working relationship with internal customers including Product Development, Professional Services, Customer Advocacy, as well as Oracle via the Oracle Partner Program


• Gather, define and document Oracle business requirements


• Work closely with application developers, other BSA’s and QA testers throughout the entire product life cycle


• Participate in customer calls, visits and meetings to gather requirements and resolve issues


• Support product rollouts and implementations as domain expert and/or primary business interface to partner domain experts. Follow product into the field to ensure customer success.


• Support current products, including 2nd level support analysis, patch assessment, and work-around investigation


• Provide business and data integration expertise to customers, partners and internal professional services personnel as needed.



Desired Job Experience:


• Requires a minimum of 1-3 years functional experience in key Oracle modules (Supply Chain Management and GTM), including requirements gathering, design, configuration, unit testing and integration testing.


• Experience with a full life cycle Oracle implementations


• Experience with Oracle ERP Cloud (Fusion) required


• Strong analytical, design and documentation skills


• Oracle design, configuration and hands on experience


• Exposure to broad financial processes and systems experience across quote-to-cash and procure-to-pay business functions (billing, order management, accounts receivable, purchasing, accounts payable, general ledger.)


• Experience with standard financial processes and ability to overlay the process understanding onto multiple financial business systems packages.


• Previous experience working in a software company strongly desired.


• Desirable experience in Oracle modules AP, AR, G/L, Order Management and Purchasing .


• Previous work with Oracle R12 EBS is a plus


• Experience with ONESOURCE Global Trade will be a plus



Other Qualifications:


• Excellent communication and presentation skills in interacting with management and communicating functional vision to both internal and external constituencies


• Strong customer-facing experience and skills.


• Experience with Agile Product Delivery Process , specifically Scrum is a plus


• Strong communication and presentation skills


• Technical/ Oracle development experience (Foundation, SQL*Plus, System Administration) is a plus


• Technical experience working with APIs (SOAP and REST) and API tools, such as SoapUi and Postman is a plus


• Ability to multi-task and work under tight deadlines in a fast paced environment

title: Analista de Segurança N1
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos a Cipher, uma empresa do grupo Prosegur especializada em Cibersegurança. A Prosegur é líder global no setor em serviços integrados de segurança (vigilância e tecnologia corporativa), monitoramento de alarmes, transporte de valores. Com uma presença internacional em 25 países a Prosegur, proporciona às empresas e lares, uma segurança de confiança baseada nas soluções mais avançadas do mercado.

Valorizamos e incentivamos o conhecimento técnico e a capacidade de inovar de Nossa Gente e acreditamos que assim é possível atingir nosso propósito de tornar o mundo mais seguro para todos.

Se você se identifica com o nosso negócio e propósito, venha fazer parte do nosso time e acelerar sua carreira.


Quais são os desafios?

  • Atender aos chamados técnicos dos clientes, focando em qualidade e atendimento do SLA acordado;
  • Ser o primeiro ponto de contato com o cliente recebendo as demandas (telefone, e-mail e Web), classificando-as e gerenciando-as durante todo o seu ciclo de vida;
  • Apoiar os processos de gestão de TI, gestão de firewall, Antivírus, AntiSpam e cofre de senhas;
  • Tratar as solicitações de serviço de forma rápida e eficiente, garantindo a satisfação dos clientes;
  • Comunicar e escalar incidentes críticos de forma eficaz, garantindo os níveis de serviços contratados;
  • Resolver em primeiro nível (FCR) as demandas previamente documentadas;
  • Realizar agendamentos de troubleshooting e manutenção garantindo os prazos de execução acordado com os clientes;
  • Monitoramento de disponibilidade e acionamento das equipes envolvidas através de alertas emitidos automaticamente pela ferramenta;
  • Realizar análise inicial de relatórios de monitoramento (Red Log, volumetria de regras) e escalonar a equipe de monitoramento se constatado alguma anomalia ou em caso de dúvida;
  • Realizar scan de antivírus e elaboração de relatório do scan;
  • Executar outras tarefas correlatas de acordo com orientação e determinação superior;


Requisitos:

  • Experiência em Suporte N1 e N2.
  • Noções de AD (consulta, reset de senha, desbloqueio de contas);
  • Conhecimentos em sistemas operacionais, redes e resposta de incidentes;
  • Atendimento telefônico e e-mail;
  • Superior completo ou cursando Tecnologia da Informação / Segurança da Informação e afins;
  • Espanhol avançado (diferencial)



O que oferecemos a você?


Na Cipher nosso beneficio é flexível VR/VA - Flash


Auxilio Home Office, para dar uma força adicional aos gastos do mês, já que estará trabalhando de casa na maior parte do tempo.

title: Engenheiro de Software Sênior PJ (Ruby on Rails)
description:
O Grupo Smart Fit é muito mais do que a maior rede de academias da América Latina e o maior empregador de profissionais de educação física do mundo. Somos um verdadeiro ecossistema focado em bem-estar e saúde, impactando a vida de milhares de pessoas todos os dias.


Estamos em mais de 15 países, com mais de 1.700 unidades, e temos o prazer de atender mais de 5,2 milhões de alunos. Nossa equipe de 15 mil colaboradores está sempre a mil, trazendo novas ideias e inovações. Desde que abrimos nossa capital em 2021, aceleramos nossa missão de transformar vidas com soluções de fitness e saúde.


Temos várias marcas no nosso portfólio, como Bio Ritmo, Smart Fit, Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, One Pilates, Velocity, Kore TotalPass e Nation CT. Além disso, oferecemos produtos digitais como Queima Diária, Smart Fit Nutri e Smart Fit Coach. Estamos sempre procurando novas formas de integrar tecnologia e inovação para ajudar você a ter um estilo de vida mais ativo e saudável. E aí, topa o desafio junto com a gente?


O que nos move todos os dias?

Somos parte da mudança, transformando o cenário e trazendo mais qualidade para a vida de quem tá junto com a gente. Cada gotinha de suor é uma prova do nosso compromisso em inspirar e motivar todo mundo que quer uma vida mais ativa e saudável. A cada dia, começamos nossa jornada com aquecimento total, prontos para alcançar novos objetivos e viver o máximo.


Modelo de contratação PJ.


O Engenheiro de Software Sênior Backend (Ruby on Rails) será responsável por:

  • Participar ativamente das etapas de desenvolvimento e entrega de funcionalidades;
  • Compreender rapidamente o domínio do projeto e o funcionamento da aplicação;
  • Propor e implementar soluções de forma autônoma, colaborando com o time em decisões técnicas;
  • Garantir a qualidade do código com testes automatizados e boas práticas de engenharia;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de produto, design e outras áreas técnicas.


Itens essenciais que não podem faltar no seu kit:

  • Experiência sólida (5+ anos) com Ruby on Rails em produção;
  • Proficiência com ActiveRecord, Sidekiq, RSpec, Devise e outras gems amplamente utilizadas;
  • Domínio de banco de dados relacional (preferencialmente PostgreSQL);
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful;
  • Conhecimento em Docker e versionamento com Git;
  • Capacidade de navegação e evolução em bases de código existentes;
  • Escrita de código limpo, testável e de fácil manutenção.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com Hotwire/Turbo;
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD (ex: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI);
  • Familiaridade com integração a serviços externos (ex: Stripe, AWS, SendGrid);
  • Fluência em ambientes ágeis com squads enxutos.

title: Analista de Projetos Pleno
description:
Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:


Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas.

Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente!


Sobre a área: O escritório de projetos atua na padronização de processos de governanç arelacionados ag estão de projetos, facilitando o compartilhamento de reports, metodologias, ferramentas e técnicas para alcançar o desafio deimplementar iniciativas com sucesso. O Analista de Projetos elabora planos de execução e acompanha deperto os projetos do Grupo Fleury, atuando também no controle e nos estudos, garantindo que todas asinformações obtidas desse projeto sejam registradas e estejam em um local de fácil consulta


Principais atividades:


  • Entender com profundidade o projeto que será trabalhado, com enfoque no valor que será gerado;
  • Agir em conformidade à metodologia estabelecida pelo Escritório de Projetos (PMO), ser um administrador diligente, respeitoso e atencioso;
  • Apoiar o superior imediato em assuntos inerentes à sua área de atuação, apresentando e discutindosoluções para problemas e irregularidades, a fim de subsidiar a definição de ações a serem adotadas eauxiliar na busca pelo melhoramento contínuo dos processos da área;
  • Criar um ambiente colaborativo para a equipe de projeto;
  • Mapear e envolver stakeholders;
  • Otimizar as respostas aos riscos;
  • Adequar o projeto de acordo com o contexto, adotando uma capacidade de adaptação e resiliência;
  • Realizar acompanhamento ativo de pendências;
  • Incluir critérios de aceitação nas entregas para garantia da qualidade e atendimento de expectativas
  • Executar outras tarefas correlatas, do mesmo grau de dificuldade mediante solicitação do superiorimediato


Buscamos alguém que apresente:


  • Pacote Office – intermediário
  • MS Project – básico
  • Métodos ágeis – básico
  • Experiência prévia na condução de projetos de diferentes portes e complexidades
  • Superior Completo (Administração, Engenharia, TI ou áreas correlatas)?MBA em Gestão de Projetos (desejável)


Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito


Informações da vaga:

  • Modelo de Trabalho (Home Office)
  • Carga Horária: 44h Semanais
  • Escala: Segunda a sexta - feira
  • Horário de Trabalho: 08h00 ás 17h48


Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!


Saúde e Bem-estar:

• Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;

• Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;

• Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras;

• Acesso à plataforma OrienteMe para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional;

• Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas;

• Acesso ao Wellhub para práticas esportivas e qualidade de vida.


Proteção e estabilidade:

• Previdência privada;

• Participação nos lucros;

• Seguro de vida.


Facilidades para o dia a dia:

• Vale-Alimentação;

• Vale-Refeição;

• Auxílio-Creche;

• Clube de Descontos com lojas, farmácias, viagem, beleza, cultura, lazer, entre outros serviços.


Desenvolvimento e educação:

• Plataforma de ensino;

• Parcerias educacionais com descontos em cursos e instituições.


Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.


Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.


Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família.


Para conhecer mais sobre o Grupo Fleury, acesse o site:

title: Salesforce Back-End Technical Lead, Brazil
description:
A OSF Digital é uma empresa líder em transformação digital com presença global em mais de 30 países e mais de 2000 funcionários. A nossa paixão é ajudar as empresas a tirar partido de soluções de comércio, marketing, vendas, serviços, análise, fidelização e experiência digital. Somos uma equipe em rápido crescimento, formada por pessoas diversas e apaixonadas por desempenho, tecnologia e satisfação do cliente. Na OSF Digital, damos grande ênfase ao equilíbrio entre vida profissional e pessoal e à satisfação dos funcionários, e nos esforçamos para criar uma cultura empresarial inovadora e aberta, ao mesmo tempo em que capacitamos as pessoas a contribuir de maneiras que tenham um impacto positivo em todos nós.


Responsabilidades:

  • Conduzir sessões de Refinamento e Grooming com clientes para entender necessidades, esclarecer dúvidas e garantir que todos os requisitos estejam bem definidos antes de solução, estimativas e planejamento.
  • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em tarefas técnicas claras e acionáveis, facilitando o alinhamento entre cliente, arquitetura e equipe técnica.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com o Solution Architect para orientar clientes sobre limitações técnicas, melhores práticas e opções de implementação, apoiando a tomada de decisões.
  • Validar soluções junto aos clientes, garantindo que os entregáveis atendam plenamente às expectativas e coletando feedback para melhorias contínuas.
  • Colaborar com o Project Manager para distribuir tarefas à equipe, revisar código e configurações, identificar problemas, assegurar aderência às melhores práticas e remover impedimentos técnicos.
  • Mentorizar desenvolvedores em tópicos técnicos e funcionalidades Salesforce, além de apoiar a equipe de QA na definição de cenários de teste, incluindo regressão quando necessário.



Requirements:

  • Experiência com Customization e Integration na plataforma Salesforce, incluindo Apex, Flows, Service Cloud e Experience Cloud (especialmente LWRs).
  • Vivência comprovada com integrações envolvendo SFCC, Oracle Integration Cloud e sistemas de POS como Tulip e TWC.
  • Capacidade de conduzir sessões de refinamento para definição de requisitos e traduzir necessidades de negócio em tarefas técnicas claras.
  • Experiência trabalhando em parceria com SA e PM, incluindo definição de soluções, orientação técnica, revisão de entregas e remoção de impedimentos.
  • Inglês avançado, com habilidade de comunicação efetiva com clientes e equipes internacionais.


A OSF Digital se orgulha de ser uma empresa que oferece oportunidades iguais, onde você pode trazer toda a sua personalidade para o trabalho. Junte-se a uma comunidade inclusiva e apaixonada de profissionais que ajudam a promover a transformação digital para empresas em todo o mundo. Na OSF Digital, acolhemos todas as pessoas e não discriminamos com base na identidade e expressão de gênero, raça, etnia, deficiência, orientação sexual, cor, religião, nacionalidade, idade, estado civil ou qualquer outra categoria protegida em qualquer uma das jurisdições em que atuamos.


English Version:


OSF Digital is a leading digital transformation firm with a global footprint in 30+ countries and over 2000+ employees. Our passion is in helping businesses leverage commerce, marketing, sales, service, analytics, loyalty, and digital experience solutions. We are a rapidly growing team of diverse individuals passionate about performance, technology, and customer satisfaction. At OSF Digital we place a key emphasis on work-life balance, employee satisfaction, and we strive to create a company culture that is innovative and open while empowering individuals to contribute in ways that positively impact us all.


Responsibilities:

  • Discusses with client to understand needs and ensure requirements are fully defined and captured before solutioning, estimating and assignment (Refinement and Grooming sessions).
  • Helps to translate business need into technical tasks.
  • Working hand in hand with SA Helps clients understand technical limitations, best practices, and options so they can make informed decisions.
  • Validates solutions with clients: Confirms that deliverables meet expectations, and gathers feedback for future iterations.
  • Works with PM to assign tasks to appropriate team members Reviews work: Provides code and configuration reviews, identifies issues , and ensures alignment with best practices Removes blockers: Helps resolve technical issues, clarifies questions with team members, and escalates problems when needed.
  • Coaches developers on technical topics and Salesforce features Supports QAs with applicable testing scenarios including regression tests where needed.


Requirements:

  • Experience with Salesforce Customization and Integration, including Apex, Flows, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud (especially LWRs).
  • Proven experience with integrations involving SFCC, Oracle Integration Cloud, and POS systems such as Tulip and TWC.
  • Ability to lead refinement sessions to define requirements and translate business needs into clear technical tasks.
  • Experience working closely with SAs and PMs, including solution definition, technical guidance, review of deliverables, and removal of technical blockers.
  • Advanced English, with strong communication skills for interacting with clients and global teams.


OSF Digital is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, where you can bring your whole self to work. Join an inclusive and passionate community of professionals who help bring about digital transformation for businesses around the world. At OSF Digital, we welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, or any other protected category in any of the jurisdictions in which we conduct business.

title: Revenue Operations Associate
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About SpendHound:

  • SpendHound is a 100% free software renewal management platform and service recently launched by the research firm YipitData. (See this introductory video from SpendHound’s Senior Product Manager!)
  • SpendHound is the single source of truth for companies’ renewal information and includes:
  • A comprehensive view of all software applications used with annual contract values, auto-renewal information, renewal dates, license counts, and more
  • An invoice and contract management system for companies to store their invoices and contracts
  • Renewal reminders through email and Slack so companies never miss upcoming software renewals
  • Free advice from procurement experts to discuss price benchmarking insights and negotiation strategies for any upcoming renewals
  • Companies use the SpendHound platform and procurement expert service to save time and money on their software renewals.
  • SpendHound is free for customers because customer data is de-identified, aggregated with other panelists, and used as part of YipitData market research (example report ).


About The Role:

Are you a collaborative consulting, analytics, or operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team?

  • Target/Territory Management

  • Operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team.

  • Your experience with CRMs such as Salesforce.com

  • You are a natural problem-solver, with a keen eye for detail and spotting issues
  • You are committed to continuously improving yourself and helping those around you

  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)

title: Software Engineer Sênior Golang
description:
Quem é Stone Tech?


A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton, Vitta e Collact, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.


Nossa cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

title: Data Visualization Specialist
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Role Summary:

We are looking for a technical builder to own our data visualization layer. You will develop custom, interactive data products for our customers using Shiny for Python and maintain rapid internal reporting using Looker Studio.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Data Visualization Product Development (Shiny for Python)
  • Architect, build, and deploy production-grade, highly-interactive data applications for customer-facing delivery using the Shiny for Python framework.
  • Lead the full development lifecycle, encompassing the design of intuitive user interfaces (UI) and the implementation of robust, performant server-side logic and reactivity.
  • Implement best practices for code quality, testing, modularization (e.g., Shiny modules), and deployment on platforms like Posit Connect to ensure a reliable and scalable data product experience.
  • Business Intelligence and Internal Reporting Management
  • Serve as the owner and subject matter expert for the internal Business Intelligence environment, primarily utilizing Looker Studio.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated dashboards and reports that deliver timely and actionable insights to internal stakeholders, effectively replacing manual reporting processes.
  • Apply advanced BI techniques, including the creation of complex calculated fields and data blending, to integrate diverse datasets for a unified view of performance.
  • Data Querying and Performance Optimization
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain efficient, production-ready SQL queries, leveraging advanced techniques such as Common Table Expressions (CTEs) and window functions.
  • Actively manage the performance layer of data visualization products, ensuring both Shiny applications and Looker Studio reports execute quickly and maintain responsiveness under anticipated data volumes and user load.
  • Collaborate closely with Data Engineering teams to understand and leverage the underlying data warehouse structure (e.g., Python, SQL).
  • User Experience (UX) and Data Design
  • Translate complex, multi-dimensional datasets into clean, visually compelling, and intuitive user experiences, moving beyond simple table and chart outputs to sophisticated data narratives.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all data products, focusing on design principles that enhance data comprehension and drive user adoption.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Aesthetic and Design Acumen: Ability to translate complex analytical findings into beautiful, polished, and intuitive visualizations, evidenced by a strong public portfolio.
  • Technical Agility: Proficiency in the core Tech Stack, including Python, SQL, Posit Connect, Looker Studio, and Git.
  • Self-Direction and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a visualization portfolio autonomously, proactively identify and implement improvements, and take ownership of the data visualization layer.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively deal with technical ambiguities and continuously seek process improvements in data product delivery.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and present complex data concepts clearly.


Requirements:

  • At least 1 year of hands-on experience working with Shiny for Python or similar interactive visualization frameworks such as Plotly, Dash, or Shiny for R , including building interactive dashboards and understanding core concepts like reactivity and UI/server architecture.
  • Expert BI Tool Experience: Strong, hands-on experience with Looker Studio, particularly in data blending, custom calculations, and connecting to various data sources.
  • Advanced SQL Skills: Demonstrated ability to write complex, performant SQL queries (using CTEs, window functions, and advanced joins) for data manipulation and preparation prior to visualization.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Familiarity with other data visualization libraries in Python (e.g., Plotly, Dash) to complement Shiny.
  • Experience with other BI platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in a quantitative or technical field.
  • 3+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on data visualization development, BI reporting, or data product creation, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

description:
Andela exists to connect brilliance and opportunity. Since 2014, we have been dedicated to breaking down global barriers and accelerating the future of work for both technologists and organizations around the world. For technologists, Andela offers competitive long-term career opportunities with leading organizations, access to a global community of professionals, and educational opportunities with leading technology providers.

At Andela, we’re deeply passionate about creating long-lasting and transformative growth opportunities for all - and doing it in an E.P.I.C. way! We’re excited to continue building our remote-first team with incredible people like you. After applying for this role, you will join our Andela Community of brilliant technologists by passing a technical screening and live interview. As a community member, you’ll have access to a multitude of exclusive technologist roles.

Join Andela today to access this opportunity and more in our global marketplace!

Our roles are typically filled at lightning speed, so if you’re considering applying, get your application in quickly!



About the client

The client operates in the health and information services domain, with a strong focus on enabling data-driven decision-making at enterprise scale. Their mission centers on building a modern, cloud-based data platform that serves as a single source of truth for business intelligence, analytics, machine learning, and AI use cases. The culture emphasizes data quality, governance, scalability, and collaboration across engineering, analytics, and business stakeholders.


About the role

This role is focused on building and operating a robust data platform on Azure using Databricks. The engineer will play a key part in DataOps, ensuring data completeness, accuracy, and reliability across enterprise-scale pipelines. You will design monitoring frameworks, implement data quality checks, and support governance initiatives. The role is highly collaborative, working closely with data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders. It also requires strong ownership and the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop a robust monitoring stack for jobs executed in Azure Data Factory, Databricks, MS Fabric, and other platform tools
  • Assist in building and maintaining data catalogs in Unity Catalog and Purview
  • Design and implement a scalable framework for data quality checks across hundreds of columns on large datasets
  • Monitor data completeness and accuracy to ensure published data meets acceptable criteria
  • Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality data solutions
  • Troubleshoot and optimize big data workflows for performance and scalability
  • Support governance and oversight of data pipelines and transformation activities
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and best practices in big data and analytics


Must have skills

  • 7+ years of overall experience in Data Engineering / DataOps
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience in a Databricks environment (any cloud)
  • Strong experience with DataOps practices
  • Strong experience with data catalogs
  • Strong experience implementing data quality checks at scale
  • Strong Python experience
  • Strong proficiency in Data Governance processes and tools
  • Experience with Purview and/or Unity Catalog
  • Advanced SQL skills
  • Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and distributed computing
  • Experience with ETL processes, data cleaning, and large-scale data transformation
  • Ability to work independently and manage priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with an analytics-driven mindset
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience


Nice to have skills

  • Experience with Azure cloud services (preferred)
  • Experience with AWS
  • Experience with GCP
  • Familiarity with version control systems such as Git
  • Experience with DevOps practices


Conditions

  • 100% Remote role , primarily aligned to UTC-5 (EST) with a minimum of 5 hours overlap required
  • Contractor role – 6-month contract, renewable based on budget and performance
  • Full-time dedication (40 hours/week)
  • BYOD requirement
